title: Vegetable Soup with Edamame, Water Chestnuts & Cilantro-Coconut Broth

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince the ginger and garlic; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and medium dice the carrots and potatoes; add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring often, until they begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies cook, seed and slice bell pepper into thin, bite-sized strips.
Add the bell pepper, broth, coconut milk, soy sauce, and sugar to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the water chestnuts in a colander.
Once the soup comes to a boil, add water chestnuts, edamame, and corn. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until edamame is heated through and veggies are tender, 5 minutes more.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add cilantro to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
